value.summary: charming opportunist. Immediate want: win the wardenship. Hidden depth: financed false escort raids without knowing injuries followed.

Gentle grump and Breadshield baker who considers praise suspicious but remembers every hungry household. Wants winter flour saved; can grade grain by touch and organize ovens; concealed the steward's debt out of compassion. Trades recipes with Bramblebridge's Gilded Kettle. A rescue plan that avoids public humiliation earns his full account.

Grandiose amateur mountain guide with six embroidered titles and only three climbs beyond the marked road. Wants to break the escort monopoly at Saint Vey's Crutch; excellent at weather signs and calming frightened travelers; hides his limited range. Apprenticed briefly under a Grey Mantle scout. He becomes honest if trusted with a task he can genuinely do well.
strict, fair Moorwatch commander. Immediate want: prove quartermaster honest. Hidden depth: fears her own family profits from army lobbying.
strict water captain. Immediate want: protect flood channels. Hidden depth: coordinates villages' deliberate invisibility.

Strict but fair former council chair who can end any speech in exactly one minute and bakes terrible diplomatic biscuits. Wants remote testimony restored at Chairman's Nap; masters procedure; fears appearing nostalgic and irrelevant. Mentored the missing League chair. Evidence of deliberate clause removal brings her back into public conflict.

the higher official who wants a stronger peace. Queen Adela's Chancellor of Roads and Revenue, composed, funny in private, and increasingly willing to manipulate law. Vane fears a succession crisis will break the Lantern Sea Accord. She uses old Concord methods to centralize tolls, messages, and emergency authority, believing temporary control can prevent war. Vane is not formally a member of the Seventh Ledger. Her confidential adviser is. She can become an antagonist, reluctant ally, deposed reformer, or architect of a less coercive system depending on what the party proves and what alternatives they build.
cringy procedural prodigy. Immediate want: become indispensable. Hidden depth: can identify every counterfeit seal except the first one he made.
dramatic orchard heiress. Immediate want: preserve one diseased grove. Hidden depth: grove marks a First Footprint line.
eccentric culinary genius. Immediate want: avoid being forced into royal service. Hidden depth: vanished voluntarily to help a dock strike kitchen.
laid-back, formidable organizer. Immediate want: keep repair dock open. Hidden depth: knows Saint Orro relic is a very good ordinary rope.
literal sky scholar. Immediate want: publish the comet's ordinary orbit. Hidden depth: has overlooked one genuinely impossible observation.
